sideB.text:
DAR ES SALAAM
6°47'33"S 39°12'30"E

SEARCH THE LAND:
[covered]

SEARCH THE SEA:
[covered]

Anchor on the compass. The bottom edge repeats DAR ES SALAAM and 6°47'33"S 39°12'30"E upside down.

states.revealedText:
SEARCH THE LAND:
We found a well-traveled path out of
Dar es Salaam.

Immediately draw a free supply line from
Dar es Salaam to another city.

SEARCH THE SEA:
[still covered]
states.effect: Land only. Immediately draw a free supply line from Dar es Salaam to another city. The sea box stays covered.

states.revealedText:
SEARCH THE LAND:
[still covered]

SEARCH THE SEA:
We have found a lost haven!
We have not yet accessed it.

Open 65 and add it to the board. If you have
already opened 65, gain 1 action.
states.effect: Sea only. Open door 65 and add that haven to the board. If door 65 is already open, gain 1 action instead. The land box stays covered.

states.revealedText:
SEARCH THE LAND:
We found a well-traveled path out of
Dar es Salaam.

Immediately draw a free supply line from
Dar es Salaam to another city.

SEARCH THE SEA:
We have found a lost haven!
We have not yet accessed it.

Open 65 and add it to the board. If you have
already opened 65, gain 1 action.
states.effect: Both boxes scratched. Draw a free supply line from Dar es Salaam to another city, and open door 65 (or gain 1 action if 65 is already open).

rules: Yellow Player card for Dar es Salaam. Port: the compass has an anchor.
Two scratch boxes, searched independently. State 2 is land only. State 3 is sea only. State 4 is both. Every state side A is the unchanged player-card back.
Land: immediately draw a free supply line from Dar es Salaam to another city.
Sea: a lost haven. Open door 65 and add it to the board. If 65 is already open, gain 1 action. The same door 65 is also on Antananarivo's sea search.
notes: Card id 10706. State card ids: state 2 is 10722, state 3 is 10721, state 4 is 10720.
Printed code P7-07b stays on every scratched face.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened. A second, non-search Dar es Salaam Player card is card 08.
